name: Thomas "stacksmashing" Roth
biography: Thomas Roth aka stacksmashing is a security researcher mostly focused on hardware and firmware. His work includes hardware attacks on processors, microcontrollers and cryptocurrency wallets, building cheap JTAG tooling for the iPhone, and attacking a wide variety of embedded devices. He also runs a YouTube channel called stacksmashing about security, reverse engineering and hardware hacking.
